title: Python Foundations
summary: Python is the language of data science. This module builds a solid base: syntax, control flow, functions, data structures, files, errors and object-oriented programming.

title: Python for Data Science (NumPy, Pandas, Visualization)
summary: Learn the core data science toolkit: fast numerical computing with NumPy, tabular data with Pandas, cleaning messy data and telling stories with charts.

title: Statistics and Math for ML
summary: Machine learning stands on statistics, probability and linear algebra. This module gives you the math you actually need, with data-driven examples.

title: Machine Learning
summary: From the ML pipeline to supervised and unsupervised algorithms, you learn to build, evaluate and compare models on real datasets.

title: Deep Learning
summary: Neural networks, computer vision and natural language processing: the technology behind image recognition, translation and chatbots.

title: MLOps
summary: A model is only useful when people can use it. Learn to deploy, containerize, track and monitor machine learning systems.

title: Big Data and Cloud
summary: When data no longer fits on one machine you need distributed tools. Learn Hadoop, Spark and the basics of cloud platforms (AWS or Azure).

title: Generative AI (LLMs)
summary: Understand how large language models work and build with them: prompting, fine-tuning, RAG and vector databases. This is the module this very book's AI tutor is built on.

title: Agentic AI
summary: AI agents do not just answer: they plan, use tools, remember and collaborate. Build autonomous and multi-agent systems.
